representation: A level launch point with a dot trajectory at the slider angle and a ring trajectory at the complementary angle, plotted on shared height and range axes.
motion: Both arcs recompute continuously as the angle slider moves; replay pulses the angle arc's apex marker.
checkpoints: 45 degrees is farthest only for level launch and landing
maximum height and range trade off
horizontal speed does not change downward acceleration
misconceptionTest: The complementary arc keeps the same landing range while its height differs, and a label plus checkpoint states that 45 degrees is the maximum only when launch and landing heights match; gravity is described as the same downward g for every angle.
accessibility: Alt text; keyboard-operable slider; dot and ring markers plus text labels identify the arcs without relying on color.
